lines: In own place satisfaction having obtained, consisting of knowledge-nectar-taste; should go to Kanda-abode in middle, sound having made soundless.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svasthāne nirvṛtiṃ labdhvā jñānāmṛtarasātmakam vrajetkandapadaṃ madhye rāvaṃ kṛtvā hyarāvakam
